notes.title: 🔥 Puzzles & Pyrologics update is live!
notes.notes:
[p]Ahoy, Sky Sailors! [/p][p][b]We’re delighted to announce that the Puzzles & Pyrologics update is now live![/b] [/p][p]At the heart of this update lies the new puzzle system, which lets you take your endless creativity to new heights. There’s a new resource, logic system, building pieces, upgrades, combat improvements, animations, and much more.  [/p][p]Several of these new features and improvements are based on your feedback, and we thank you all for making your voices heard! [/p][p]As the Steam Summer Sale goes live later today, [b]Aloft will be 20% off until July 10[/b], so tell your friends and grow your own dream sky-village. [/p][p]Watch the Launch Trailer and soar smoothly into the new update: [/p][previewyoutube="OA0IV8M-d80;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Get an overview of the new features below. Our team is already getting a head start on the next update, so keep on reading until the end to find out what's on the horizon! 
 [/p][h2][b]🧩 Puzzles & Pyrologics 🔥[/b] [/h2][p]Using the new Emberstone resource, you can now build and power your own trapdoors, rotating walls, pressure plates, levers, timed triggers, and all sorts of clever contraptions. Mining Emberstone is a bit more involved than simply bashing it with a pickaxe. You’ll first need to break the exterior shell to uncover its red-hot core, then cool it with water to further mine and gather it. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/c4e95ba99a57de926a5eaf5a48c09af60e9e60aa.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This new resource can be used to power the Pyrologics system, which is how you design your own puzzles. Connect a resonator to a windmill to generate a field in which the new pieces can be placed, such as a pressure plate. The specific interactions and results you want can easily be tailored on the Pyrologic board (think of it like a circuit board). [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/87cbf48adc6030d238cd78272b50b79e00fd4053.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Ready-made puzzles can now also be found out in the world. Solve these ancient riddles to earn various rewards. Perhaps they’ll even serve as inspiration for your own puzzles! 
 
 [/p][h2][b]☁️ ️New Wonder Islands ☁️[/b] [/h2][p]Uncover lost secrets on new Wonder Islands filled with puzzles to solve. Unlike the one-off puzzles you’ll find scattered across the skies, these are larger hand-crafted islands containing interlocking challenges, a story to tell, and Pyrologic pieces to sketch. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/e0ce0c69d426d92ba03c494ff26b9375f3a0b665.jpg"][/img] [/p][h2][b]⚔️ Combat Improvements ⚔️[/b] [/h2][p]Difficulty scaling is now based on the area of the map, rather than on how many islands you’ve cleansed, which should provide a smoother experience. We’ve also made improvements to balancing, visual feedback, and animations, both for enemies and for players (leap, block). And if you’d like a more peaceful experience, or a harsher challenge, check out our new difficulty settings, now found in the options menu. (Yes, peaceful mode is now [i]truly [/i]peaceful!) [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]🛠️ Building Pieces & Decorations 🛠️[/b] [/h2][p]In addition to the Pyrologic building pieces, we’ve added Emberstone lamps to brighten up your contraptions! This update also brings a variety of other new building pieces and upgrades, such as the new vertical windmill, designed to catch wind from any direction! There’s also the much-requested custom stretchable rope and various equilateral triangle building pieces.  
 
 [/p][h2][b]🤝 Player Contest Islands 🤝[/b] [/h2][p]The results of the Island Creator Contest we held on Discord were incredible, and we’re including some of the best ones in this update! These islands will appear seamlessly in the sky like any other. Explore them to uncover their unique stories and reap hidden rewards waiting to be discovered. 
 
 [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/fc9e07024ac05d07c182d6bcd329f19fe3a0ab74.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/526472884483260785"]full Changelog[/url] for a more detailed list of changes. [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]🔭 What’s on the Horizon 🔭[/b] [/h2][p]Peek through the spyglass for a glimpse at what we’re working on:  [/p][list][*][p]New world generation, an improved system that will set the foundation for future updates [/p][/*][*][p]Sailing upgrades and wind lanes [/p][/*][*][p]Progression system revamp [/p][/*][*][p]Life trees tied to ecosystem restoration [/p][/*][*][p]New enemy and corruption tiers [/p][/*][*][p]New tools and weapons [/p][/*][*][p]New decoration options [/p][/*][*][p]Reward system and character customisation [/p][/*][/list][p]We can’t wait to share more about these features soon!  [/p][p]Aloft will be 20% off as part of the Steam Summer Sale, going live later today and ending on July 10. Soar the skies with your friends this summer.    [/p][p]See you in the clouds! 🌥️ [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/954b2f796ab6f3c15a94ea17327770cd4f1f896b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Critters & Wonders Update is Here! 🦋
notes.notes:
Ahoy, Sky Sailors!  

Our first major update is now available!  

Say hello to your new best friends in the sky – Critters! In today’s update, the world of Aloft welcomes new life. Take a look at our video showcase below: 

[previewyoutube=3XXkDLq46eU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Collect all the critters! 🦇🐸 [/h2]

Starting today, critters can be found scattered across the world of Aloft. Bees, butterflies, bats, frogs, lizards – you name it. Pick them up to look at their beauty up-close! These little fellas are key to a healthy ecosystem, and that’s where you come in.  

Catch them (carefully!) on any island using the net or lure them with feed in order to bring them with you on your journey across the sky. Wherever they live, the ecosystem benefits so make sure to introduce them to new environments – the more, the merrier! You can even spoil critters by building fancy vivariums for them on your home base.  

Players can also build landing pads to ensure animals land safely after sending them home. Additionally, animal bells can be placed to call all or a specific group of animals back to their pen or enclosure – perfect for shear or meal time! 

Critters come in all shapes, colours, and rarities – so be on the lookout for unique and uncommon patterns! 
 
[h2]Wonder Islands 💭  [/h2]

During your travels, you may now come across a new kind of island in the sky, called Wonder Islands. These islands are fixed in the world and always offer a unique reward or discovery. 

In today’s update, we’ve added two Wonder Islands. Explore them to uncover mysterious ruins, rare treasure, and other secrets. We look forward to adding more of these diverse islands in the future, filling the sky with unique experiences. 

[h2]Shared Homes 🤝  [/h2]

After listening to community feedback, we've decided to offer players an easier way to collaborate together on a single island. Now, when placing a Home Kite, you can choose to create either a Personal Home or a Shared Home. Shared Homes allow all players in a multiplayer session to cooperate, build, and teleport to their Shared Home without requiring permissions. 
 
Shared Homes are world-bound, so they cannot be spawned in/out (for now). If you’d like to revert a Shared Home back to a Personal Home later, you can do that too.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/190bbb968f7073fa7d43e50dd2596f20f9e1cd3d.jpg[/img]
 
For the full list of changes, including a number of quality-of-life, server, and performance improvements, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/525336841073723439]you can check out the changelog here[/url]. We want to express our gratitude to all of you for your support and for playing Aloft. We’re always listening to your feedback, and can’t wait to share more of what we have in store!  

As always, if you come across a bug (of the technical variety), don’t hesitate to report it and we’ll jump on it like a critter with a treat. 

And as a last surprise: starting on March 13th, Aloft will be part of the Steam Spring Sale, making it the perfect time to invite your friends, build your dream skyship, and explore the skies – at a discount! 

See you in the clouds! 🌥️

notes.title: DEVLOG - MOMENTUM 🏃‍♂️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/41f4543bd3d05c8d62991c44a67a3afc8d3288b8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/4091c0649a5792c85b1effcfcf71a3017dcc64b1.png[/img]
Out with the old and in with the new: [b]say goodbye to stamina and hello to momentum![/b] Why the change? Through extensive internal reviews and valuable community feedback, we found that stamina often felt restrictive and counterintuitive to our feel-good vision for the game. Thus, [b]momentum has replaced stamina,[/b] focusing on [b]rewarding positive actions[/b] with a high-risk, high-reward approach. This change promises a more dynamic and enjoyable gameplay experience, while still providing a [b]resource management[/b] aspect to the system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/3afedbb180471dfbf66fd0c8353780fa9d1e1d4f.png[/img]
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/52e587b822ced809ddbde74debfc5e9217857f3b.gif[/img]
Momentum is a [b]new system[/b], taking the form of a resource that you can [b]accumulate[/b] and [b]spend[/b] for [b]powerful effects.[/b] Performing exciting actions will [b]build your momentum,[/b] while other actions will cause you to [b]spend[/b] or [b]deplete it.[/b]

Momentum is displayed through a [b]momentum meter[/b] currently below your health bar. [b]By default,[/b] the player has [b]three momentum charges[/b] and can [b]build up to five charges.[/b] The [b]maximum[/b] amount of charges you can hold is [b]influenced by various factors,[/b] including the food your character consumes, the gear they wear, and the conditions affecting them.

The player may use momentum in various ways, but [b]spending momentum[/b] typically requires [b]consuming one full charge[/b]. [b]Incomplete[/b] (semi-full) [b]charges deplete[/b] during [b]inactivity.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/9e7c8761a2c2c9850ee5205930a67d6a555be4ae.gif[/img]
[b]Momentum can be easily charged through tool-based resource gathering:[/b] using the pickaxe on large stones, the axe on trees and burnt stumps, as well as the sickle on wild plants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/0fee2ce3eb1b54bc5c496611007e2c7e666e6621.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/9e53e0d617d749057bac701bb0574306c8180ed1.gif[/img]

While gliding, momentum can be obtained in different ways:
[list] [*] [b]Regular gliding[/b] charges momentum slowly.
[*] Gliding into an [b]updraft[/b] charges momentum quickly.
[*] Gliding [b]close to an island[/b] also charges momentum quickly, depending on how close the player is to the ground.[/list] [b]Glider boosts[/b] now consume momentum. After the [b]first free boost,[/b] every [b]subsequent boost[/b] requires spending a full momentum charge. The first free boost becomes available again after a cooldown period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/6702370967b3381645983c063e9816281cd60aac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/acfe78f8d53ff36f89042d19babe47216dcb78ff.gif[/img]

While in combat, momentum can be [b]obtained[/b] in the following ways:
[list] [*] Successfully [b]blocking[/b] and [b]striking[/b] an enemy charges momentum.
[*] Successfully [b]striking[/b] an enemy with a [b]charged attack[/b] and/or [b]combo finale[/b] charges momentum.
[*] [b]Getting hit[/b] by an enemy or the node charges momentum (like an adrenaline rush!).
[*] [b]Destroying[/b] corruption flora (purple and orange mushrooms) charges momentum.
[*] [b]Attacking[/b] the node’s weak points and inner fruit charges momentum.[/list]Full momentum charges are [b]spent[/b] to perform [b]combat manoeuvres.[/b] Performing a [b]charged attack[/b] (leap or upslash) or a [b]ground pound[/b] will consume a momentum charge and the attack will be enhanced.

Momentum charges can also be used to [b]automatically heal yourself[/b] (by gradually consuming charges) while sitting or laying down, which is useful after a challenging battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/b20b05f5d8ef1e4c22f22f7c6449224e123b15d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/778db6b45d68450d29f029c47e5749819f4b35e2.gif[/img]

The following conditions grant or remove momentum charges:
[list][*] [b]Enthusiastic[/b] [list][*] Restoring an island’s ecosystem provides the [i]Enthusiastic[/i] condition, which grants an extra momentum charge. [/list] [/list] [list][*] [b]Wet[/b] [list][*] Exposure to rain or wading through ponds causes the [i]Wet[/i] condition, which removes one momentum charge. [/list] [/list] [list][*] [b]Hydrated[/b] [list][*] Drinking water, or consuming any liquid-based meal (such as a soup or smoothie) produces the [i]Hydrated[/i] condition, which grants an extra momentum charge. [/list] [/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/21d2b33267eb3720be9d3b95c4561e7c6e3c2f0c.png[/img]
The following systems are not implemented yet, but are planned for the future: [list][*] [b]Repairing Sails[/b] [list][*] Sailing through environmental hazards (such as storms or jetstreams) may damage your skyship’s sails; repairing them will charge momentum. [/list] [/list] [list][*] [b]Gliding with Birds[/b] [list][*] Gliding alongside birds flying in the sky will charge momentum. [/list] [/list] [list][*] [b]New Conditions[/b] [list][*] Zippy: Drinking Coffee produces the [i]Zippy[/i] Condition which will grant you an extra momentum charge. [*] Exhausted: Gliding too far from a cluster, falling to the void, total health depletion, and environmental hazards (such as fainting from a heat wave or being struck by lightning) will produce the [i]Exhausted[/i] condition, which removes a momentum charge. [/list] [/list] Lastly, here is a sneak peek at the [b]new UI[/b] planned for momentum, situated in the HUD. The [b]momentum meter is located below your conditions,[/b] so you can quickly identify which conditions may be affecting your charges. Additionally, the reticle will conveniently change in appearance from [b]white to yellow[/b] when there are momentum charges [b]available for use.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/d60b1e2446f991dc38977d53e6833bb10ec827a1.png[/img]
That’s all, for now! We hope this was helpful in understanding the change and how the momentum system works. Please keep in mind that [b]this system is still new and may be subject to change[/b] during the polishing and balancing phase, and as development progresses to incorporate additional gameplay features. We’d love to hear your thoughts on the new system and its UI – your feedback is crucial as we refine it further!

notes.title: DEVLOG - ECOSYSTEM RESTORATION 🌳
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/41f4543bd3d05c8d62991c44a67a3afc8d3288b8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/4091c0649a5792c85b1effcfcf71a3017dcc64b1.png[/img]
Once upon a time, our island was a thriving paradise. The air was filled with the cheerful chirping of birds, the trees stood tall and vibrant, and the plants flourished in a harmonious dance of colours. But now, due to fungal corruption and unsustainable gathering, the birds have stopped singing, the trees are lifeless, and the plants are overridden by invasive weeds. The ecosystem's vitality has reached an all-time low.

But all is not lost! It is up to you, explorer, to breathe life back into this once-beautiful haven. Together, we will learn how to restore balance and revive the symbiotic harmony of the ecosystem.

[b]Welcome to the Ecosystem Restoration Devlog.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/3ac6898e991fda60ade3fbae9d8f9cec7dd23ca3.png[/img]
The first step to identifying an island in need of rejuvenation is to take a look around and examine the visual cues symptomatic of [b]low vitality[/b]: dull colours, wilted and invasive plants, vine barriers, unharvestable crops, sick trees, and animal bones. While travelling, you can use the [b]Table-Map[/b] and/or [b]Spyglass[/b] to identify these low vitality islands from a distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/6a38d1488707b5e5940f51fd024b80f08659ba2d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/81b31abc8cbc818273a79146e1159e77e8387a01.png[/img]
In order to help restore the island’s ecosystem, craft a [b]Field Guide[/b] by combining Leaf Cloth, Rope, and Paper on the Workbench. Using the Field Guide, you can [b]study the ecosystem[/b] to determine what it requires to be fully restored; use that green thumb of yours to [b]equip seeds[/b] and [b]plant trees, various flora,[/b] and [b]decomposers[/b] on the island. Soon, you will be able to [b]introduce critters[/b] and other [b]animals[/b] by transferring them over from other islands or by building a birdhouse. The Field Guide also [b]highlights in red[/b] any [b]hindrances[/b] such as sick trees that need to be chopped down, corruption nodes that need to be destroyed, and birdhouses that need to be repaired.

[b]Once you've met the Field Guide requirements, watch as the island's ecosystem transforms and comes back to life right before your very eyes![/b] [i]feels good[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/1fb84ac6e38953e7ef2b87f50e6c51bec7339547.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/22378dd7958d92eeca0d3ac8a1df4af1099c9ce9.png[/img]
There are several rewards to gain after restoring an island’s ecosystem; you will literally be feelin’ good as you’ll receive the “[b]Enthusiastic[/b]” condition, which boosts your running speed, attack speed and damage, as well as momentum capacity.

Additionally, you will be able to [b]harvest special crops[/b] that were previously overrun by weeds, [b]access chests[/b] and [b]different areas of the island[/b] that were previously blocked by vines, and [b]tame animals[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/cee84377e3dbc1f066e44514f8eba14a88f68057.png[/img]
The current Ecosystem Restoration mechanic is an introduction to what we have planned. Here’s a glimpse of what’s to come:
[list][*] [b]Animals Adopting You[/b]
[list][*] To move animals between islands, you will have to first restore the ecosystem. Once the ecosystem is restored, an animal can adopt you, enabling you to relocate them to another island or bring them back to your home base. [/list] [/list] [list][*] [b]Dream Herbs[/b]
[list][*] Dream Herbs are a unique crop that will be found on low vitality islands. Restore the ecosystem to gather them!
[*] The consumption of Dream Herbs will allow you to lucid dream and control your progression (more info on the Dream System later). [/list] [/list] [list][*] [b]Life Trees[/b]
[list][*] Each Tablemap sector contains a Life Tree, a massive tree species that wilted with the coming of the corruption.
[*] Restoring the ecosystems of all islands surrounding these trees will revive them, revealing a vast hollow chamber at their roots that grant access to hidden rewards.
[*] Restoring the Life Tree also imbues the sector of that biome with benefits, like favourable weather, revival of long-lost crops, and more.
[*] Life Trees and its Saplings will grant Life Fruits: these fruits will have various purposes, notably for animal breeding and the Stormchaser system. [/list] [/list]
Here's a sneak peek at the Life Tree concept.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/e46a92890d86dbe8cf5c9968384e710f36d71ffe.jpg[/img]

So, get ready, Sky Sailor! With your Field Guide in hand and a heart full of hope, embark on this enchanting mission to reinstate balance to the natural environment. Remember that [b]the ecosystem is counting on you[/b] — give to it and it will give back. Happy exploring, and may the winds of restoration carry you forward. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/160f68d3dd8b9c24348227f46810eed033e99f10.png[/img]

Looking for other explorers to restore the ecosystem with? Join our Community Discord!

notes.title: New Multiplayer Demo Out Now, Funcom Joins the Team! 🕹️

Hello Sky Sailors,  

We have been promising big news, and well, tie yourselves to the mast, because the winds of change are here! A brand-new multiplayer demo, a publishing partnership with Funcom, and a Fall 2024 Early Access release date! Join us above the clouds in our new trailer:

[h2]New Multiplayer Demo [/h2] 

It’s time to band together, Sky Sailors! Our multiplayer demo is now available to play, with up to 8-player co-op and a deluge of new features. Multiplayer will be available until June 17 as part of Steam Next Fest, after which the demo will remain for solo play.  

Here’s the list of changes:  

[list]
[*] [b]Multiplayer:[/b] Create a veritable sky village with up to 8-player co-op. Why not try out a slightly lopsided flying V formation?  
[*] [b]Frescoes:[/b] Find repositories of ancient knowledge to discover new technologies.  
[*] [b]Ecosystem Restoration:[/b] Heal and fortify islands’ ecosystems with the help of the new Field Guide.  
[*] [b]New Resources:[/b] Rock salt, and charcoal.  
[*] [b]New monster:[/b] The Coward. He lives up to his name and will catch you by surprise.  
[*] [b]Sketchbook:[/b] Find ruins and wrecks to discover new decorative building pieces with the aid of your Sketchbook. 
[*] [b]Momentum System:[/b] Skillful fighting and gliding accumulate momentum, which allows you to execute powerful maneuvers. Destroy corrupted nodes to unlock new combat moves.

In this Devlog, we will be unveiling our new UI/UX direction — featuring major improvements to aesthetics, readability, and functionality. All of these menus are a work in progress and subject to change, so we’re really looking forward to hearing your feedback. Let’s take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/1a5d9b1d29b114da0fed2b9882fb048f436c828e.png[/img]
Changes to the start menu are simple yet effective; a higher contrast menu bar to improve visibility and readability, as well as some familiar motifs for decoration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/1d88d30d0d20a66d6f4fd00cb3d9640e95a7c0cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/a2509867a23508f08f4c78bd428e094118535274.jpg[/img]

A complete overhaul of the head-up display is in effect — featuring a new health gauge, conditions, notifications, and more. The first image shows how the HUD would appear most of the time, while the second image displays all possible notifications, including multiplayer widgets 👀. Missing from this image is stamina! After gathering some feedback from the community and reviewing the stamina system, it has been decided that stamina will be replaced with a momentum system. More details on the momentum system will be shared in a future Devlog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/c5667898a2f7a16deff3ff39c949ac8e6b02f586.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/82de9fec4e42c2ed0a412f6860b9a8cb0d95c46e.png[/img]

notes.title: DEVLOG - CORRUPTION, NODES, AND ENEMIES! ⚔
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/41f4543bd3d05c8d62991c44a67a3afc8d3288b8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/cadef2a3ada08ff2b5060295bc6eb23fce7d804d.png[/img]
Greetings, Sky Sailors! In this Devlog, we will be doing a deep dive on the evil minions of Corruption, the enemies! Let’s get to it.

To learn more about these ferocious foes, we must first understand their purpose and why they exist in the first place, so let’s talk about Corruption.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/cbe3cd5e518ec2d756b574992d9f488fd91b81b0.png[/img]
The game’s antagonist, the Corruption, is a mysterious invader in the world of Aloft. It is an infectious parasitic fungi that aims to completely overtake an island’s ecosystem by preying on other fungi, but also on fauna and flora. Visually, Corruption is always disproportionately large and pulsating, with unnatural colours. It can reproduce and grow fruiting bodies that protect themselves through a variety of defence mechanisms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/ae5151b3db75d81614f071e9e6feb8e42d7f944d.png[/img]
The Corruption presents itself in 3 different strains: Mykter, Sportox, and Flogade. They each have a visual language and general rules that apply to each of their forms.
[list]
[u]Mykter:[/u] is recognized by its yellow vines and small, fibery mushrooms.

[u]Sportox:[/u] is recognized by its orange tissue and spore fumes.

[u]Flogade:[/u] is recognized by its black tissue, spikes, as well as its red, scorching hot ooze.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/e9e2729a988937e0b0b43639864c53399a295a06.png[/img]
The Corruption features central fruiting bodies called Nodes, which are the heart of the parasitic infestation. Nodes can alert nearby monsters when attacked, endure substantial damage, and even spawn new monsters to claim the upper hand. Cleansing a Node involves safely destroying its protective outer shell and inner fruit without spreading its spores, resulting in the restoration of the island and the death of all that once contaminated it. While destroying a Node prevents its immediate threat, uncleansed roots may lead to its eventual regrowth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/f6bfe52d370bd1ecc063038541151b77a255a07d.jpg[/img]
The Mykter Node, despite being the lowest tier strain, is a very powerful entity. It appears as a towering structure with the ability to fully corrupt an island. Using its solid cage-like shell and dangerous independent tentacles that aim to ensnare players, it is very successful at keeping undesirable intruders away from its spore-producing core.

Now that we have a better understanding of Corruption, its strains and Nodes, let’s learn about its sinister servants!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/2e03e8c60bc501c5331492a921f36a8aaa8b512e.png[/img]
Who are the enemies you ask? They are mushroom-like monsters that serve as the keepers of Corruption. They can only be found scattered on corrupted islands, are activated when players walk near them, and by disturbances to the Node. They are combative creatures that aim to protect the Nodes at all costs! There are four enemy types (for now 👀) in the world of Aloft: the Guard, the Coward, the Shrieker, and the Devourer. Each enemy can exist in all three of the fungi strains, with more dangerous variants situated at the highest altitudes and inner rings of the hurricane. Fun guys, amirite?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/89457412158de3a88d769a74fe0fc6b38a4f108d.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/85e9fc69c952b2889a039587f03394458bdd429a.gif[/img]
Guards are the frontlines of Corruption, and can be found dormant in large numbers on infected islands. Guards will awaken and attempt to overwhelm the player by their sheer number and relentless strikes. They pose a significant threat, especially when combined with other enemy types. The Guards will even go as far as leaping to reach players, but return to dormancy if they are unable to engage them. If that wasn't enough, higher strains of Guards can use their mushroom cap as a shield, hindering frontal attacks, and sometimes throw it at their foes to incapacitate them from a distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/bb57c6340df5da04eb334c5236452c857652be33.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/a4c37cb57cb3a6c17a338d64df0992bfaa641ff0.gif[/img]
Cowards, like their name suggests, are annoyingly cautious adversaries, preferring to avoid direct confrontation and fleeing when they feel threatened. Cowards become courageously confident when allied with other enemies or positioned advantageously, resulting in them celebrating minor victories and taunting players. Despite being one of the weakest foes, they rely on pestering players by throwing projectiles at them from a distance, aiming to maintain the space between them. This forces the player into pursuit to eliminate them, which distracts from other threats. Cowards can even hurl projectiles while the player is airborne, adding complexity to defensive strategies. Higher Coward strains may dodge projectiles, and can inflict damage overtime with their attacks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/69fef14433073ed0e4b99f53b04f3de437d12fef.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/57165a403b80befcc80d72d90346a1d8cf2a59d7.gif[/img]
Shriekers, while capable of defending themselves, also prefer indirect conflict, and provide support to their allies. Often found attached beneath islands like starfish, they awaken to fly amidst enemy hordes, using their heads to inflate to an impressive size. They then use the amassed air to emit a piercingly loud shriek, bolstering their allies on the battlefield. Agile in flight, they pose a challenge when engaged in aerial combat, as they swiftly evade heavy airborne assaults. Using their drill attack, they charge at players and inflict damage upon contact. If this special strike is successfully dodged by the player, the Shrieker becomes temporarily immobilised, granting an opportunity for a counterattack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/c82094170a3257c534d3174e3fe819e13e61e457.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/7d87fda81b2b65141a1137f63ee83e6080f39caf.gif[/img]
Devourers, acting as formidable mini-bosses, exhibit remarkable destructive agility and displacing abilities. Indifferent to their allies or environments, they inflict harm by periodically transforming into ball form, rolling towards their opponents. Their bouncy mushroom cap aids the player in gaining height during combat. Devourers can be tripped to expose their weak point using an upslash or charged leap attack, thus interrupting the roll attack, and rendering them prone and vulnerable. They struggle to regain footing in this state and are susceptible to further damage. Higher tiers of Devourer are more aggressive in their rolling behaviour and use of displacing abilities.

That’s it, folks! We hope you now have a better understanding of Aloft’s enemies and the Corruption for which they protect. We look forward to seeing our players engage in a variety of combat styles to defeat the enemies, cleanse the Corruption, and restore islands back to their original state.

[i]All content and features presented in the Devlog are subject to change in order to offer the best possible experience to players.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/160f68d3dd8b9c24348227f46810eed033e99f10.png[/img]

Before ending the Devlog, we want to share some small updates with you:

We recently hosted a building contest on our Discord! Participants were given four categories to inspire their submissions: Sailing, Building & Decor, Gardening & Animals, and Machinery & Automation. Let’s take a look at the finalists!

Congratulations to the winners!

The Wiki is a community-run initiative, so feel free to contribute by creating new articles or expanding on existing ones. We have a dedicated forum on our community Discord to discuss all things Wiki.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/3e34562a2563e43a55f3774743c47a0554b6da02.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/41f4543bd3d05c8d62991c44a67a3afc8d3288b8.png[/img]
With September coming to an end, we find ourselves returning to our work routines, even though we never truly paused. Summertime tends to bring a slightly slower pace that benefits our well-being.
Now you might be wondering, what's the latest scoop?

As you might have read on our Discord, one of Astrolabe’s accounts was hacked. We have since restored the situation and secured any other port of entry. We want to assure you that the development of the game was not hindered by this situation and is still moving along at a good pace. However, as a security measure we removed the demo on steam to make sure it would not infect the build. While we have now recovered the accounts, we want to take this opportunity to finish working on the next update before putting the demo back online [b]this fall[/b].

Before then, the Aloft demo has been continuously online since June 2022. We hope that bringing the demo back after a short break, along with a substantial update will be better for the game reach and discoverability. We thank you for your understanding, patience and ongoing support, we promise the wait will be worth it!

In the meantime, as we said, we’ve been busy and growing! Allow us to introduce not one, not two, BUT THREE fantastic new members to our team: Betty, our gifted UX/UI Designer, Joseph, our exceptional VFX Artist and Hayley, our amazing Community Manager.

Bringing these talented individuals on board meant saying goodbye to our old office and relocating to a new one! We’ll share some more pictures of the workplace on our Discord, you’ll have to join it to see for yourselves.

We are thrilled about our new spacious location, which accommodates everyone comfortably. As our team expands and our game continues to evolve, our happiness knows no bounds! This beautiful space does not come easily, we had a month of construction work that slowed the development a bit.

You might already be aware that we took part in the[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A_gekVYenCg] Future Games Show at Gamescom[/url], unveiling a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Il9P7iSV46c]new trailer[/url]. In case you missed it, here's your chance to catch up!

Our game is now available on a new platform, [url=https://www.greenmangaming.com/games/aloft-pc]Green Man Gaming![/url]
We work hard to increase the visibility of our beloved game, so we are absolutely delighted about this new addition. Here's to hoping that many new players discover our game through this platform! Don’t worry though, the game will stay available on Steam!

At its core, Aloft isn’t just about combat, but we know that overcoming challenges makes the rewards even sweeter. These new combat animations allow players to build an expertise, improve their skills,  and will allow us to make the monsters better, faster, stronger!

[h3]
Welcome, dear readers, to this exciting Summer Tiiime edition.[/h3]
In this devlog, we embrace the advice of[url=https://howtomarketagame.com/] Chris Zukowski[/url], an Indie Video Game Marketing expert, to let go of numbers and inject a touch of fun into our devlog title.
 
As we bask in the warmth of summer, we hope you're having a fantastic time. Although the weather in Quebec may be a bit peculiar this year, with smog, rain, and even the occasional tornado (albeit a slight exaggeration), it only adds to the uniqueness of the season. Amidst it all, Montreal shines as the ultimate summer destination, offering a myriad of activities, cultural events, and inviting terraces where you can relax and enjoy a refreshing drink with friends.
Aside from indulging in the delights of summer, we also put in diligent efforts toward our work! Let’s dig into that, shall we? 

First and foremost, we couldn't bear the thought of being apart from our talented 3D Artist intern, Anthony, so we invited him to join us full-time and he said yes! Prepare to be amazed by his incredible work, which will be showcased very soon.

We recently had an absolute blast participating in Comiccon Montreal! It was an exhilarating experience to meet friends from our Discord Community and great Content Creators like [url=https://twitter.com/Game_Edged/status/1680693469709316097?s=20]GameEdged[/url]. Being able to showcase our game live at physical events is always a special moment for us.

Have you had a chance to play the recently released "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/3665415870869623962]Fluffy Update[/url]" the latest version of our demo?
Our game designer, Nico, has created a[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5fLK3FlwqGw] perfect video showcasing the exciting new features[/url]. The research lab is used to know more about corruption and how to find a cure.  You will be able to analyze unknown fungal fibers to discover new strains of corruption. Once a strain has been discovered, you can make experimental fungicides and test them against corruption.  Bring the samples back to the research lab to learn more about the strain and discover new technologies related to finding the cure. The remedy can then be used to cure animals, plants, leviathans and corrupted islands. Once the cure has been found, further research can be carried out, unlocking even more technologies to help you get rid of the corruption!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/ea6528f7cb9747a8f497e9140d8cca672eae8c91.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/8ef2e0c3ac2b6c2d0a91c1f245077fcdebe6f1ff.png[/img]

[h3][b]All customization will be available in the next update! [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/974ee886670c28614800598f786c5bde969faf81.png[/img]
Say bye bye to our last placeholders, Mary finished all our very own custom trees! 
They will be implemented in the game soon but Max has to develop the system behind it before, so patience is advised!


Alright friends, that’s it for this devlog! We hope you enjoyed reading these new pieces of information about our development.

As always, we post news weekly in our Discord, we try to answer every question and chat with the community every day! You are more than welcome to join us :) 
If you have any suggestions / questions for the next update, don't hesitate to share it with us! 

Cheers travelers ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/e90301899177c39ecf28b59528095d86d598283a.png[/img]

The purpose of the terrarium is to grow different strains of fungi to aid in your research to find a cure to  corruption. The last, and most recent, piece of news is amazing: [b]we were lucky enough[url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1629457180167380994?s=20] to win the Ubisoft Indie Serie grand prize[/url]! [/b]In addition to the prize money, we will receive support from Ubisoft, something truly invaluable. We’re really happy to share this night with [url=https://www.luciddreamsstudio.com/]Lucid Dream Studio[/url], who won the second prize, offered by the[url=https://www.bnc.ca/] National Bank of Canada[/url]. You should check out their newest project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430220/BIOMORPH/]Biomorph[/url], it’s really cool!
What a day to be part of the Indie community! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/cac138c4c4b67436e70f3dbbeb8246c1491e00b6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Now, what are we working on?[/h3]
 
As you may know, some islands in the game are corrupted by dangerous fungi. This corruption won’t only attack the players, it’ll target the animals as well! Jeremy, our VFX artist, is currently working on the creeping effects of this corruption on the creatures. For the occasion, we wanted to share with you the artistic evolution of the sheep. The wool can look a bit thin at the moment, but it’ll grow over time in the game to be super fluffy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/4ac8039aea9715f914d99c067bbf3baee9c06832.png[/img]

Corruption, animals and corrupted animals aside, our team is moving forward on a lot of projects: 

[h3]Concept Art - Kenzie [/h3]
Kenzie has been working on the alchemy concept for the last weeks.
You already know that, in the game, you can build a base, fly your own island, grow your own veggies… A new, cool, feature will allow you to develop your alchemy skills! 
We can’t spoil everything yet because there is so much new cool stuff coming, but here is the concept art for the terrarium! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/7d27228287893fc4d92b74e0710dd43c21cd3be1.jpg[/img]

[h3]3D art - Mary Jane [/h3]
We were waiting for these for a while now! 
Though that’s the case in the current version of the demo, inventory will not be infinite in Aloft. Fortunately, you will be able to decorate your home and organize your inventory with the new chests. 
Nico, our game designer, showed them in exclusivity during a Twitch Stream. He is live most[url=https://www.twitch.tv/nico_astrolabe] Fridays at 3 pm EST[/url]. Join us! It’s fun to chat with you live and share exclusive stuff. The [url=https://discord.gg/XA8KkzYY]Discord server[/url] is by far the best way to know if a stream is coming. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/5af38e9e887b39b7d42b578bbfc36963b761434d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Character customisation - Calvin[/h3]
Character customization is a feature that many of you requested and so Calvin modeled all the different faces in 3D. The final system will have a lot more options such as body types, skin colors, hairstyles and much more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/2cd694c6aeb3ce95576a81559f5ffd35fe7f2d67.png[/img]

[h3]Animal animations - Emma [/h3]
Emma is currently animating the upcoming animals.
Every Thursday, we do a review session internally and everybody shows what they are up to. Emma’s presentations have been SO cute and this is one of the reasons:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/571cdbec2c54dc0b8fca2a6240d1e2c067001090.gif[/img]

[h3]VFX - Jeremy [/h3]
We’re so thrilled to see the VFX coming to life with Jeremy's work! 
The team is growing, every week we can see the game getting better and better. It’s a really rewarding feeling. One of the first VFX that Jeremy worked on is the Fungi fighting effect! It is still a work in progress but we can promise that the combination of sounds and VFX will have an impact. We will show it to you soon.

[h3]Sound Design - Kyle [/h3]
It's so exciting to share Kyle's work for the first time. Sound adds something so special, so relaxing to the game, we think it fits the environment incredibly well, but we will let you be the judge of that. Tell us what you think!
[previewyoutube=hsw8gb8VYvg;full][/previewyoutube]

Manuel, our CEO, and Felix, our Producer, will be at GDC to meet with the professionals of the gaming community. 
Are you going too? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/UTwuSHTp]Discord[/url] to let us know!
2023 will be mostly about development and growing our community but we’ll give you details when the time will come.

Cheers travelers 💫

notes.title: The base building update - Devlog #10
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there travelers, settle down and listen,[/h2]

Hello everyone! 

Happy new year from everyone at the Astrolabe Interactive studio! We really hope your holidays were restful and that you could spend time with your loved ones during that period or since then. We took some time off to take a breather and prepare ourselves for what is going to be our biggest and most intense year ever! 

We started the new year strong with a new team member; Jeremy is our VFX and technical artist, responsible for all the shader and VFX work in the game. He just got here, so be kind to him, he has a lot of work on his plate! We are 12 people now, almost a full team. 

[h2]New demo update[/h2]

Now for the big, important, amazing part. There’s a new demo update, and it’s coming out today! If that comes as a shock to you, it’s because you’re not on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC]Discord server[/url] or following us on [url=https://linktr.ee/aloftgame]social media[/url], because we’ve been talking about this for a while now! We decided to launch it at the start of the Steam Base Building Fest to celebrate all the awesome creative energy our fans have been putting in Aloft. 

So the demo is getting an update, all the things mentioned in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/3631620304673118730?l=english]last devlog[/url] will be there, of course, and much more, but that’ll be in the last section of this Devlog. 

Another HUGE and AMAZING news is that we have a new trailer out! You just need to go on the FRONT PAGE OF IGN to watch it! We’re honestly amazed that IGN decided to showcase our game, it’s such amazing news! We really hope that this coverage will help Aloft get a lot of visibility, wishlists and new Discord community members. 

[previewyoutube=omcvQIQKmGw;full][/previewyoutube]

Furthermore, we’re also flabbergasted at the new video the youtuber Real Civil Engineer cooked up for us. He takes the time to present the game for new players, but also tries and break the limits of the demo in his own unique brand of humorous creativity. You should really take a look at it, it’s well worth the time to watch it. 

[previewyoutube=xACDyBwdreA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Photo contest[/h2]
One of the new features included in the demo is the Photo mode! Our programmer decided to make it during his holiday break, because he’s just that great. There are still some things to polish, but we’ve been taking just the prettiest photos and screenshots out of it! One thing we learned in the last couple months is that our community is creative like no others and that’s just the best. To encourage that creativity, we organized a photo contest for you to participate in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/f7152664d2a3dd0811f86a8ffcd9834880791a11.gif[/img]

The rules are simple: there are 4 categories to participate in and you can submit one photo per category. If you are picked for the best photo in your category, you get a (secret) prize! The categories are:
[list]
[*] Best base (it is the Base building Fest after all)
[*] Best photo overall
[*] Best Tiny House (because it’s cute)
[*] Most creative construction
[/list]
To participate, simply use this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe4w00CmGAUBuPJxA9hjKNpeOsJboUj5P-pbPhwgKqq46Enkg/viewform]Google form[/url] and drop your screenshots! There are more rules and information needed in the form, so make sure you read everything. 

Of course, any kind of inappropriate content will result in an immediate disqualification. Stay wholesome folks!

[h2]What has changed since last time?[/h2]

All the stuff in the last devlog is going to be in the game, but there’s more too! Since he got onboard with the team, our composer/SFX has been hard at work implementing sound effects to the game. They are still unfinished but at least there’s sound in the game now! The infamous sound bug that plagued many of you has received a temporary patch. We are confident that it should fix the bug, but if it still happens, please let us know in the discord channel #feedback-bugs. 

We have some VFX added to the game as well, all that Jeremy has had time to work on in his few weeks with us. It’s not much yet, but it absolutely helps the game feel more alive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/0766da54aca9878fad83173a2bde0a759319b4fa.png[/img]

Character and monster animations are mostly done! Some might need a little rework, but otherwise they are complete! We’re really happy to see the game come alive with assets, animations and effects made in-house. It absolutely makes all the difference to the visual experience.  

For a more comprehensive list of changes, please consult the changelog [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/3651890488926875862]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/eb8a58ee130ac7e317b836b0695c6fcabd0bf2c8.png[/img]

[h2]Private playtest[/h2]
Finally, we had a private playtest last December and our testers had a great time and were super professional and useful! Our deepest thanks to all who participated in the playtest! Thanks to them, we revised the gliding controls and added a cookbook to remember all your recipes! For anyone who hasn’t been able to participate, there will be more and the best way to know about them is to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC]Discord server[/url]!

[h2]Friends of Aloft[/h2]
We always like to share our time in the spotlight with friends! If you want to flex your science brain-muscles, look no further than [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1510440/view/3668778987525688684]Honeycomb[/url], where you can bioengineer the flora and fauna of a whole planet!

We also encourage everyone to take a look at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2071430/Roots_of_Yggdrasil/]Roots of Yggdrasil[/url]! It's a viking city-builder currently in development by our friends at [url=https://www.manavoid.com/en/]Manavoid Entertainment[/url]. They have a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wearemanavoid/roots-of-yggdrasil-a-post-ragnarok-roguelike-city-builder]kickstarter [/url]coming soon, so keep your eyes peeled for that!

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
2023 will be a big year for us, actually the biggest so far! We have a bunch of new team members in every discipline quickly ramping up to peak efficiency, and we need them! We’re aiming for an Early Access release at the beginning of 2024, which means that we need to get to work and make an amazing game for everyone to enjoy!

For now, we’ll let everyone enjoy the Aloft demo during the Base Builder Fest and the Games from Quebec Fest over the next two weeks. We are absolutely looking forward to seeing all your beautiful creations in the Photo Contest!

In the meantime, thank you all for reading and stay wholesome!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/fe369ad9311194f5ff3e309e754e577f03385ff8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Real Civil engineer plays Aloft!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The famous engineer-youtuber Real Civil Engineer is playing Aloft! Take some time to discover our new features and the demo update as it goes live!

Of course, the video is also available on Youtube, please check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/@RealCivilEngineerGaming]Real Civil Engineer's Youtube Channel[/url]!

What if Raft was set in the sky? Aloft is an incredible fun survival game where you can engineer islands into huge floating bases! Check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/16... and thanks to the devs for sponsoring the video!

There is also a photo contest split into 4 categories: Best Base, Best Photo, Best Tiny House and Most Creative, each with a prize to the winner! Enter here: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe4w00CmGAUBuPJxA9hjKNpeOsJboUj5P-pbPhwgKqq46Enkg/viewform]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe4w00CmGAUBuPJxA9hjKNpeOsJboUj5P-pbPhwgKqq46Enkg/viewform[/url]

[b]About Aloft:[/b]

Aloft is a sandbox survival game where you must survive on islands floating around an eternal hurricane at the center of the map.
Build your base and sail the winds to discover new islands and find new resources, technologies, and equipment upgrades, while fighting back fungi corruption.

Learn more about your origins as you uncover secrets from the ruins of a civilization long gone, and find the answers to their demise by reaching the highest altitudes and braving the challenges of the hurricane.

[b]Creative Sail Crafting
[/b]You have ultimate freedom when the time comes to craft and build sails for your island. The height and width of masts can be adjusted, the sails, rotated and expanded, and custom sails allow you to move anchor points around and inflate/deflate the cloth, letting you craft any decoration your mind can imagine. The sails you craft are then used to navigate your island around the map, navigating the wind currents and jet streams to move faster.

[b]A life in the clouds[/b]
Craft buildings to protect you from the harsh wind, or that let the wind pass through, build bridges and zip lines to move quickly across your archipelago of floating islands, farm crops and raise animals by gathering water from passing clouds, erect windmills that will automate your machines, and gaze at the beautiful scenery. Jump off and fly freely using your glider, dancing with birds and clouds alike.
[b]
Cleanse Corruption[/b]
Some islands are corrupted by a dangerous force of nature in the form of a fungi infection. Dangerous and colorful mushrooms grow on top of the contaminated flora, and animals are victim to the corruption. Learn how to develop treatments for the various forms of the fungi, and cleanse the corruption from the islands. By healing and freeing the ecosystem, get access to new animal companions, livestock, crops, and resources. 

[b]Brave the Hurricane[/b]
The giant hurricane in the middle of the map hides the answers to your past and future in its eye. Rock fragments, lightning strikes, toxic spores and freezing temperatures make the journey through it difficult. If that was not enough, the bellows of ancients leviathans can be heard through the storm.

[b]Wind Automation[/b]
Build windmills to harness the power of the wind and automate machines across your island. Optimize your windmill placement and hunt the best winds to power your production. Create automated oars to move your island, machines to craft advanced resources or even traps to protect your islands against enemies.

[b]Island editor[/b]
Create your own island in the Island editor. Save it to appear in your game or export it to share your creation within a friend's game!

[b]8-player co-op[/b]
Jump into an adventure with up to 7 other friends, and conquer the skies together. Chain off attacks while fighting as a group, take on a meaningful role in your day-to-day activities, and help your team sail and find new discoveries while exploring.

notes.title: The winter update - Devlog #9
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there travelers, settle down and listen,[/h2]


Hello everyone! We are so happy to see you again!

Winter settles comfortably in Montreal and you can feel that the holidays are around the corner. 
The streets are lit up, cheerful music is playing and the Christmas markets are in place, along with the city's ice rinks! 
This is the perfect season to stay cozy near a warm fireplace right? This is exactly what we did the last couple of weeks so we don’t really have anything to share…
 
Just kidding! We have SO many news for you! 
 
First, since [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1660080/Aloft/]the last update[/url], our team has grown considerably. We are fortunate to welcome 5 new members : 
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6984167411474128896/]Solene[/url] : our Project Marketing Manager
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6985609987997761536/]Emma [/url]: our Rigging & Animation Artist
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6988146572609867776/]Vincent [/url]: our Game designer 
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6988501924643807232/]Calvin [/url]: our 3D Character Artist 
[*] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7000842162951122944/]Kyle :[/url] our Composer & Sound Designer 
[/list]
Our team is up to 11 people now, we are really happy and proud.
[h2]
Community involvement[/h2]
With Solene’s arrival, we’re developing our social platforms. If you want to support us, we are now on: [url=https://www.facebook.com/AstrolabeInteractive]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/astrolabe_interactive/]Instagram [/url]& [url=https://www.linkedin.com/company/astrolabe-interactive/?viewAsMember=true]Linkedin [/url]

Every Thursday we share Kenzie's beautiful concept art through thematic posts. For example, the last one was about [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1598315992970629124?s=20&t=FIicud34bAKks6sEZB7NWw]eye colors and facial hair[/url].

On Saturday, we follow the ScreenshotSaturday trend and post a [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1596496495775293440?s=20&t=FIicud34bAKks6sEZB7NWw]screenshot of the game[/url].

We also try to share regularly [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1596181604040597505?s=20&t=OM7_vvFVf_nEfCtm3YQVPA]about various topics[/url], without any particular agenda, so stay in touch :) 

It goes without saying that [url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC]our Discord[/url] stays the best way to communicate directly with us. It’s always such a pleasure to exchange with you all. We answer every question, suggestion, comment… and show exclusive content.

Last October, [url=https://megamigs.com/en/]Megamigs[/url] took place in Montreal and we were lucky enough to be [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1583835474812350464?s=20&t=2Lo_jx56yxflVfusp9e-Hg]among the participants[/url]. It was so good to chat with the different actors of our community from all over the world. Many players enjoyed our demo and the feedbacks were very encouraging. This experience was very positive and reminded us how much we appreciate physical events. 

We also participated to the [url=https://twitter.com/GamePlaySpace/status/1593652267173003267?s=20&t=OM7_vvFVf_nEfCtm3YQVPA]November Play test[/url] organized by [url=https://www.gameplayspace.com/]GamePlay Space [/url]in Montreal. It was a very formative event, we took many notes and [url=https://twitter.com/Aloft_Game/status/1596172150008053766?s=20&t=OM7_vvFVf_nEfCtm3YQVPA]interacted with a lot of friends[/url]. 

We’re amazed that more than 270 videos have been made on Youtube about Aloft. Big names continue to be added to this list with Meatwagon22 creating a series of 7 videos about our game, go take a look! 
[previewyoutube=a97j7VtU6pQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Cooking[/h2]
In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/3297221237685553462?l=english]the last devlog[/url], we discussed farming and all the great produce you could get out of it. There’s more to come regarding farming, but that will be for a future devlog, as there is still a lot of design work to be done before we can announce anything. In the meantime, we decided to get busy with the logical successor of the farming system: the cooking system!

Our designers have built a very flexible system that allows players to combine many different food items in order to make all sorts of meals, no matter what combination you input! Of course, that amused the fans on our Discord server to no end, as they are really looking forward to break our system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/5a670fa984d4d96f443639175621ac05d302a964.gif[/img]

In short, you need a heat source, either a campfire or a fireplace, and a cooking plate. By interacting with the cooking plate, you can input three ingredients, which will slowly cook over time. If you feed the fire with coal and if you actively cook the meal, it will go even faster! But watch out, you might end up with a burnt meal, which is never very appetizing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/350bcb6c8ad642d434aa353f3375571f248dbb07.png[/img]

The ingredients you use actually determine what kind of meal you’ll get (provided it’s not burnt). Is it a soup, a skewer, a stew or a salad? Who knows! You will need to try it to discover it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/83354f0bbc360301dda5591d98fcb42eb9ec8d66.gif[/img]

[h2]New character model[/h2]
One comment that came back many times was that our player character model had a bow & arrow on his back, but that we didn’t have a bow & arrow! Well, that’s because our model was a placeholder while we hired the perfect 3D character artist. Calvin is now part of the team (see 1st paragraph) and he worked on an amazing character model over the last month and a half. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/5b75d9e7365bba22a8e4d8fa97c93a571cfbc041.png[/img]

The character and its outfit is inspired by maritime cultures and sailor clothes. As you have seen on [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7004098494835621888]our[/url] [url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:6999025536580669441]social [/url][url=https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7001570864156606464]media [/url]over the past few weeks, we have a lot of character customization options in our pipeline, but we decided to make a single character for now. It will be of course a lot of work to create all of those options, we will let you know whenever it’s ready to show!

[h2]New character animations[/h2]
Emma, our new rigging and animation artist has also been hard at work making the animations for both our new player character, but also for the guard monster! Fighting him is much better now that there’s proper animations and its falling animation is very funny to look at. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/ef45c9ecf1e2c34f7b27b05d5ec24a3f8a0e067b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/e8639a8549622963a7b75039dd74d241b85c8276.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/2887bbc1ee5db6fc94e373cd36c655c9f54c979d.gif[/img]

Working on animations is a lengthy and complex process, so the animations you see above are not final. We will keep working on them until they are perfect. Of course, there will be much more animations to keep everything lively and varied. 

[h2]
Doors & Windows[/h2]
Sometimes, in the development cycle, we have to cut some things short to make sure we reach our objectives. That means that some things are left for later, like at the end of our milestones, when we try to wrap everything up and do all the things we didn’t have time to do before. A good example for this are doors and windows! The assets themselves were done a while ago, along with the last wave of construction pieces (like the doorframes…).

Well those assets are now implemented! You can have a door in your house! It doesn’t change much, but it’s one more building piece that our players can play with. And hey, now they swing like a saloon door, which is pretty funny to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/9887b8664ac0e7e97b753948a2f3231664e5870e.gif[/img]

[h2]Survival system[/h2]
The last thing to mention here is the upgrade of our survival system. Up to now, people had health points and stamina galore, monsters were hitting like wet noodles and globally there was little challenge in the game. Now, there’s a lot of new things to consider during your playthroughs. 

First of all, stamina and health have been greatly reduced, which means you now have to manage those resources with greater care than usual. Additionally, eating food and meals now gives you additional bonuses that will make survival easier and more efficient. 

Furthermore, now there is a more cohesive approach to our survival system, with stamina, resources and health being resources to trade with each other, emphasizing the “survival” aspect of Aloft. We will keep tweaking and working on it to make the experience better and better for our players. 


[h2]What’s next?[/h2]

notes.title: The farming update - Devlog #8
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there travelers, settle down and listen,
[/h2]
Hello everyone! Remember how we said we would be working at a reduced pace for the summer? Well, we had a lot of fun, we took some vacations to enjoy the nice (fickle, humid, hot) Quebec weather, and now we’re back on track to keep creating a badass, awesome, fun and wholesome [b]Aloft [/b]game!

Hello everyone! Since the last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/5862012459303247824]update[/url], time flew by us and now has come the season of harvest, cold evenings and warm beverages (pumpkin spice optional). In Quebec, fall is the season of apple picking, warm cider and slowly realizing that snow is coming, for better or for worse. For Aloft, however, the weather doesn’t stop us from pursuing our goal of making the best game we can!

Since the last devlog where we talked about the Next Fest results, the navigation system overhaul and new assets related to navigation, we had a bunch of new features implemented in the game, as well as several quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes. As always, the patch notes will come with the update itself, but more on that later. 

If you want more regular updates and engage with the community, we do encourage you to join our discord, it’s full of good stuff, and we share updates more often and in a more casual way. 

[h2]Community involvement[/h2]
Ever since we showcased the game during the Next Fest, we’ve kept receiving great feedback from players all around the world and videos kept coming out about the demo. People are just having a blast playing Aloft and that’s so nice to us, it really gives a boost to the team’s morale and encourages us to work even harder. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0vRokXUL3Ew]Some [/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CEzzGLh6G0E]big [/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pYs5WafMpGk]names [/url]in the Youtube game even made videos on Aloft, it’s awesome! And now we’re happy to announce that we reached 1000 members on our Discord! Everyone has been awesome, they have great suggestions and impeccable taste. You should join them ;) 

[h2]Additional building blocks[/h2]
We really want Aloft to be a game about creative freedom, but you need brushes and oils to paint a masterpiece! We already have several building pieces with which to build your islands, but we missed a couple. They will also allow you to use more rocks and rope in your projects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/e82260e64f783b2c2485b8ab659871795c51e35d.png[/img]

Players will now have access to delightfully wavy spiral staircases, stone building parts and rope fences. The staircase was tricky to implement in regard to other building parts, but we think the end result is great and adds a lot of character to staircases. It’s also promoting safety in the workplace, which is always a good thing. 

With these stone foundations, players will finally be able to get rid of all their excess resources by building rock-solid buildings. 

[h2]Farming[/h2]
We are working on the farming system! After preparing the ground, planting the crops and watering them is a wonderful way to become an active part in the creation of biodiversity. Monoculture can be harmful to the environment, that’s why we created a whole bunch of plants and crops that players will be able to grow and harvest. In a later update, we will include [b]cooking and permaculture[/b] systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/fbb7f8080b6ff92d772ec2ad71110f1f0c111bec.png[/img]
The Dorkip is the primary farming tool. Praised by our discord members (for reasons unknown), the Dorkip is a fictional tool combining a gardening hoe and a short spear. The result is something that will allow you to plow the earth and defend it against fungi creatures!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/de7f56806149a3a180becd24bc9d5cf57fd38ee5.png[/img]

An essential accessory - the bucket - is currently available in two formats: the leaf bucket is cheap to build and contains little water. The wooden one holds more water, but is more expensive to craft. Both have their uses, and they are quite pretty. The water system is still being worked on, so the only way to fill your bucket is by interacting with a pond. Keep that in mind when choosing your farming-focused island!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/303719fbcd8b0d7788b894917db70618d41f2d71.png[/img]

Finally, of course, farming wouldn’t be farming without being able to plant crops! To allow for the funky layout of some of our fanbase’s custom islands, players will have to put down plots of land before planting their crops. Those will grow better when watered properly, of course!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/a88b24a4f77d327b4950aedd0159435286c73dc1.png[/img]

[h2]UI and french localization[/h2]
Most of the UI in the current demo is a placeholder that worked while we implemented the different mechanics and systems of the game. Now that we have a better understanding of the visual identity of the game and of the user experience, we wanted to overhaul most of the UI to better reflect that. I think you’ll find it’s much prettier and easier to use. Full disclosure, some of the UI is not final as we are still working on it and implementing new systems. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/96281de83aed2509fb73b0ed886e4980338a9e75.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, we will also implement a first version of our French localization. Having a team that is mostly bilingual in French and English allows us to localize our game properly in those languages. Just like the UI, it will be a work in progress as we implement more features and correct the bugs we find along the way. 


[h2]Demo update[/h2]
So when will you see all those fancy assets and new mechanics? As early as next week at the time of publication (September 30th, 2022). In addition to what was already mentioned above, we will add more assets, fix some bugs and add some quality of life changes. Of course, a changelog will be published along with the update, containing all the changes. 

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
We are in the process of expanding the team and to make sure we have all the skills needed to make the game of our dreams happen. Our first new teammates will join us next week and we’re still hiring more!

After the update, the demo will stay up for the foreseeable future. We really enjoy seeing everyone playing our game, making videos on it and giving us such great feedback. Thank you all so much for your support and we look forward to seeing you around the hurricane.

notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there travelers, settle down and listen,
[/h2]
Hello everyone! Remember how we said we would be working at a reduced pace for the summer? Well, we had a lot of fun, we took some vacations to enjoy the nice (fickle, humid, hot) Quebec weather, and now we’re back on track to keep creating a badass, awesome, fun and wholesome [b]Aloft [/b]game!

Since the last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1660080/view/3209389638431888643]devlog [/url]where we talked about tools, corruption, enemies and all that good stuff that’s still in the demo for you to enjoy, we kept working at a reduced pace, but that doesn’t mean we didn’t work though! We took the time to improve the visuals and the gameplay of the game to add more systems, improve the pacing of the demo and, of course, interact with our awesome community. 

If you want more regular updates, we do encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC]Discord[/url], it’s full of good stuff, and we share updates more often and in a more casual way. 

[h2]Next Fest[/h2]
In early June, we put out a pre-alpha demo for the Steam Next Fest to see what people would think of our upcoming game and the answer was astounding! We had more than 100K views on our streams, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3V6901hHQag&t=25s]100[/url]+ [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sSOHft_63xc&t=52s]gameplay [/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V49SnC89njU&t=48s]videos[/url], tens of thousands of new wishlists and hundreds of [url=https://discord.com/invite/q7D8semyUC]Discord [/url]members, the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive, and it’s telling us we’re moving in the right direction. 

The demo we put up for the Next Fest has been kept up, because we like having people play the game and have fun!

[h2]Navigation system overhaul[/h2]
As you may have noticed in that previous GIF, the sailing system has been completely overhauled to make it better, more intuitive and with a more depth as well! Now, various sails offer different levels of flexibility, wind efficiency and durability. Players can also build [b]rudders [/b]to help steer the island and [b]floaters - horizontal sails -[/b] which enable vertical movement. The new sails must be strategically placed to help you pilot your island through the more dangerous areas of the hurricane, whereas the other structures provide necessary guidance to the island. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/ba8400b78d24a2000d768ddd7b41b842e8d88bb9.gif[/img]

[h2]New assets[/h2]
In addition to the navigation system overhaul, we also implemented new assets for the sails, windmills, helm and rudder! Those are way nicer than 

The current sails are made of leaf fabric, which is the lowest tier of fabric available in the game. It’s not very resilient or efficient, but it’s cheap and easy to make. Leaves are a fairly common resource to find after all! They’ll be the very first thing new players will use to sail their islands and explore the world of [b]Aloft[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/9aa2c973f3a4fe5fad12e7f49254fb2d7df50576.png[/img]

The windmills we’re very happy about, they look great and have a bunch of customization options available to them right now. Just like the sails, windmills are limited to leaf fabric for now, but you can select different blade patterns and amounts. We think they look absolutely badass, and some players have been putting them to great use. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/9d554bb3ff198008e2fd4b657cf9fca7b778cc27.gif[/img]

Finally, the helm has been upgraded from its placeholder status to full-fledged 3D asset! It works in the same way, as the piloting center of your flying island. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41880788/b7482404e7517ab01e18699ee7e411b4415290ff.png[/img]

[h2]Survival fest[/h2]
Next week, we will be participating in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/steamworks/announcements/detail/3222900587040657570]Steam Survival Fest[/url]. Of course, the game will not be on sale (as it is not being sold at all) but a new version of the demo will be up and running for you to try out! We have addressed several bugs, improved the gameplay and added tutorial features. You can find the full changelog in the patch notes posted next week along with the new demo. Of course, a new demo means that previous saves will be destroyed which is a bummer, but at this stage of development, we are unable to make old save files compatible with new versions.

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
For the rest of the summer, we’ll be working on bringing our animal concepts to life, but also to make our own non-placeholder character model! We have great concepts we cannot wait to show you, and with Joanna on board, it’s going to look amazing in 3D as well. 

We’re also working on improving our starting biome, to bring to the level of quality we expect to have upon full release, it is one step closer to our full-blown vertical slice which we’re hard at work bringing to life. 

Given the additional team members, the higher rhythm of work we’ll be taking on, you can expect more devlogs to come, roughly every month, or earlier if we have important, urgent news to share with everyone.
